postings.title: IT Engineer Intern (Early Careers Summer 2027)
postings.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
As an intern at Affirm, you will be a contributing member of our outstanding engineering team, and as such you will work on meaningful projects and frequently ship code. Recent grads and past interns have built a real-time high-throughput data processing pipeline, developed an extensive automated testing framework, and built out our proprietary financial platform that is central to our long term company mission.
We are excited to meet and consider strong students for our 12-16 week internships. We are a dynamic organization that is happy to tailor projects to your skills, and we will work with you throughout the interview process to determine which team will be best for you.
What You'll Do
Interns are responsible for developing and shipping a project and verifying that it works in production. Because things are changing fast at Affirm, we do not specify intern projects in advance, instead you will collaborate with your mentor and manager when you start to spec a project that will best contribute to your team.
• This role will ship code and monitor the deployment of your work. Our intern projects are not isolated or intended to be thrown away: your team will depend on your contributions!
• We pair interns with a dedicated mentor who will be by your side to give advice and ensure the success of your project. Expect to meet with them on a regular basis and receive feedback.
• There are opportunities to attend events with other interns and full-time Affirmers! Past events have included virtual cooking classes, executive fireside chats, cable car trolley tours, and Giants games.
• Interns present their work to the entire engineering organization at the end of the internship.
What We Look For
• Passion and dedication to changing consumer banking for the better
• Experience with Python, C/C++ or Java
• Frontend experience in WebApps/JavaScript/AngularJS/React
• Strong communication skills
• Experience with object oriented programming
• Deployment and testing frameworks
• API development/documentation
• AWS or other PaaS frameworks
Compensation is a set amount for the Intern role with no range.
USA hourly base pay: $50.00
USA monthly base pay: $8,700
Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:
• Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
• Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
• Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
• Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.
We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.
For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.
By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

postings.title: Accounting Intern (Term-Time, Part-Time)
postings.description:
About Akuna:
Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market-maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies, and mathematical models.
Our Founding Partners first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, London, and Singapore.
What you’ll do as an Accounting Intern at Akuna:
Akuna is seeking a part-time Accounting Intern to join our Finance team during the school year. This is a hands-on role where you'll work directly with experienced accountants and see how finance operates inside a global trading firm. We're looking for a detail-oriented, proactive student who is eager to learn and comfortable working independently. In this role, you will:
• Perform daily bank reconciliations
• Support month-end close, including journal entries and account reconciliations
• Investigate discrepancies and propose solutions before escalating to your manager
• Maintain organized accounting records and supporting documentation
• Support external audits
• Take on ad hoc projects across the Finance team as they arise
Qualities that make great candidates:
• Currently pursuing a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (sophomore standing or above preferred)
• Solid grasp of basic accounting principles and financial statements
• Proficient in MS office software with intermediate Excel skills
• Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail
• Excellent verbal and written communication
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
• Available to work approximately 15 hours per week in our Chicago office during the academic term
• Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required on the first day of employment including F-1 students using CPT, OPT or STEM
In addition to technical skillsets, Akuna values the unique perspectives people can bring to the table to collaboratively solve complex problems and drive Akuna forward. We want everyone to feel empowered to apply. We welcome your application and encourage you to take the first steps toward your future with us!
In accordance with Illinois Equal Pay Act, the minimum hourly wage is $25/hour. Exact compensation offered may vary based on many factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set. The minimum base salary herein was determined in good faith by Akuna Capital LLC.

postings.description:
場所：AlphaSights東京オフィス
Location: AlphaSights Tokyo
Client Service Associate への本選考を受ける準備として、ワークショップイベントを開催します。
イベントでのパフォーマンスに応じて、特別選考プロセスにご招待します。
Are you looking for an opportunity to jump into a real working space? Autonomy, high personal impact, and an introduction to the world of business without pigeonholing yourself into any one industry? 日程：

• 2026年12月5日 (土)

postings.title: Internship (m/w/d), Client Service, German Speaker, 2027
postings.description:
Location: Hamburg
Start date & duration: September 2027 for 6 months
Looking for an internship with commercial frontline responsibility and the opportunity to work on live client projects? Do you seek to have immediate personal impact? If so, our Client Service Internship program is the right choice for you.
Consider the Client Service Internship program if:
• You thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
• You possess a client-first mindset.
• You excel under pressure and enjoy using tech-enabled workflows to meet tight deadlines.
• You are gritty, resilient and ready to roll up your sleeves to make things happen.
• You enjoy the opportunity to regularly upskill on new tools and workflows, including those powered by AI, to improve your professional output.
A day in the life of a Client Service Intern
As an intern in the Client Service team, you’ll be the link between our clients and the expert knowledge they seek. Throughout your workday, you’ll work on multiple projects from investors, strategists and dealmakers at top-tier client organizations seeking expert insights to inform their decision-making. This is a communications-intense frontline role requiring you to multitask across parallel workstreams.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Owning end-to-end client-expert communications, spending a significant part of your day on the phone screening and negotiating with relevant experts to position the best possible matches for your clients’ requests.
• Leveraging AI-powered sourcing tools to map complex industry value chains and identify and engage with relevant experts.
• Understanding the project and market context and the legal and regulatory environment in which your clients and experts operate.
Ensuring success for our Client Service Interns means:
• Giving you an introduction to the business world without being pigeonholed into any one industry or profession.
• Helping you develop transferable commercial and client management skills spanning professional communications, negotiation, persuasion, project and time management.
• Providing you with a mentor, dedicated time with senior leadership, and the opportunity to deliver a business-related project to our co-founder and Region Head.
• Opportunity to receive a full-time employment offer to return post-graduation. Learn more about our commercial career paths here.
• A unique training curriculum and intense on-the-job coaching, helping you develop highly transferable commercial and managerial skills.
• An inspiring, high-energy, merit-based environment with ambitious peers.
Requirements
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree or doing a gap year
• Available to undertake a six month internship starting in September 2027
• Internship or working student experience along with extracurricular achievement throughout school and/or university is highly valued
• Experience evidencing an interest in business
• A self-starter mindset: enthusiasm, drive for success, strong initiative as well as excellent communication skills
• Fluent written and verbal English and German skills at C1 level or above is required; experience living or working abroad is desired
Compensation and benefits
• 30.000€ annual base salary (pro rated for six months) plus commission based on performance
• 28 vacation days per year
• Pension plan from Signal Iduna Germany
• Our fast-growing office, right across the Elbphilharmonie, has a special flair: with around 60 employees, we’re at the size where everyone knows each other and appreciates working together (Monday to Thursday in the office, Fridays home office)
• Monthly team events, free breakfast and snacks, subsidy for local public transport and lunch, iPhone and MacBook Pro complete our modern, professional working atmosphere.

Automation & Controls Engineering Associate (Summer 2027)

• Collaborate with environmental test, mechanical, electrical, reliability, manufacturing, and software teams to build safe and repeatable test solutions
Requirements

• Experience through coursework, projects, research, internships, clubs, or personal work in one or more of the following areas:
• Electrical circuits, instrumentation, sensors, or data acquisition
• Embedded systems, PLCs, or industrial automation
• Control systems, state machines, or hardware/software integration
• Strong proficiency in Python
• Clear written communication skills and the ability to work effectively on a cross-functional, hands-on engineering team
• Willingness to work in a lab or factory environment and perform hands-on hardware tasks

postings.title: Quantitative Trading Intern - Summer 2027
postings.description:
Belvedere Trading is a leading proprietary trading firm proudly headquartered in downtown Chicago. Our traders work hard to provide liquidity to the market through their market-making activities and are the masters of a diverse set of commodities, interest rates, exchange-traded funds (ETF), and equity index options. From the beginning, we began iteratively investing in our proprietary technology and committing to building our systems from the ground up. Our trading models and software systems are continually re-engineered, optimized, and maintained to stay on top of the industry. This wouldn’t be possible without the dedicated efforts of our technology teams who utilize and perfect our innovative technology solutions.
High-performance proprietary trading and development is the source of our success and competitive advantage at Belvedere, further fueling our passion for performance. We are a team driven by intellectual curiosity, seeking answers that will change not only how we trade in this technological age, but also the future landscape of the trading industry.
At Belvedere Trading, Quantitative Trading Interns are some of the industry’s highly motivated most quantitative problem solvers. They have a love for financial markets and enjoy working in teams to learn about various trading concepts. Our Quantitative Trading Interns participate in a hands-on rotation between Belvedere’s trading desks and collaborate with Developers and Strategists in research to improve our trading systems. Our Interns are at the forefront of technology immersion as they learn best practices in software development and focus on projects related to trading logic development, electronic trading strategies, and quantitative research. If you love technology and financial markets, then this position might be for you.
Don’t know a lot about trading? No sweat. Learn as much as you can in the meantime (check out our FAQ page for some resources to get you started) but know our Belvedere Trading University (BTU) program will teach you everything you need to know once you join the team.

• Daily trading activities – Assist with analyzing daily trades and recapping significant trends
• Rotations – Rotate between product groups to gain a broad understanding and knowledge of the market and Belvedere’s trading strategies
• Desk strategy – Engage in daily collaborative strategy adjustments with your team to adapt to market dynamics
• Research – Participate in quantitative research and the application of quantitative strategies while learning concepts behind our core market making operations
• Data Analysis – Analyze extensive datasets to extract insights that bolster our trading strategies
• Training – Benefit from our industry-leading BTU program, complemented by ongoing practical training within our trading operations, covering a spectrum from foundational knowledge to advanced proprietary concepts.

• Curious – We'll teach you everything you need to know, but we love working with people who ask questions and are eager to get involved
• Communication – We need people who can speak confidently and concisely especially when the stakes are high
• Analytical – We’re looking for quantitative thinkers and master problem-solvers with strong data analysis skills
• Team Player – Trading and development are not isolated activities at Belvedere, so great candidates will have demonstrated success in working in team-based environments

• Core development skills – You will need some training or a demonstrated ability to learn programming languages such as C++, C#, and Python
• Knowledge of the financial markets and trading industry isn’t required, but it is a plus!

postings.title: Applied Research Intern, Proactive Intelligence & Customer World Models (PhD / Graduate Co-op)
postings.normalizedTitle: applied research intern proactive intelligence & customer world models
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
postings.description:
Team: Apollo — Block Applied R&D
Location: Remote (US / Canada)
Duration: Fall/Winter 2026 co-op — 8 months, flexible start September 2026
Level: Graduate student (MS or PhD, returning to your program after the co-op)
About Apollo
Apollo leads Block's efforts to build the Customer World Model (CWM): a continuously evolving representation of each customer's goals, context, history, constraints, and likely future needs.
The CWM powers proactive intelligence across Block's ecosystem. Instead of customers navigating products in search of features, intelligence observes their world, understands what matters, anticipates what comes next, and initiates actions on their behalf.
We believe the next generation of AI products will not be defined by chat interfaces or isolated agents. They will be defined by rich world models that enable systems to reason over a customer's evolving state, make better decisions, and learn continuously from outcomes. Apollo designs, prototypes, and guides the development of this intelligence layer.
About the role
We're hiring a small cohort of graduate research interns to help build the foundations of proactive intelligence.
This is not a traditional internship. You'll own a research problem end-to-end: framing the question, developing methods, running experiments, publishing findings, and, when successful, shipping your work into production systems used by millions of customers and sellers.
You'll work at the intersection of representation learning, foundation models, reinforcement learning, causal reasoning, agentic systems, and product intelligence. The goal is not simply to build smarter models, but to build systems that develop a deeper understanding of customers and use that understanding to make better decisions over time.
Past interns have shipped production systems within months and published their work in the same year.
What you'll work on
Depending on your interests and Apollo's roadmap, you'll focus on one or more of the following areas:
Customer World Models
Building rich representations of customers from event streams, financial activity, operational signals, and behavioral data.
Examples include:
• Representation learning over long-horizon customer histories
• Event-based foundation models
• Multi-modal customer representations spanning structured, sequential, and graph data
• Memory architectures for long-term customer understanding
Proactive Intelligence
Developing systems that can anticipate customer needs and initiate helpful actions before being asked.
Examples include:
• Opportunity detection and next-best-action systems
• Long-horizon planning and decision-making
• Preference and goal inference
• Learning when intervention creates value versus friction
Agentic Decision Systems
Building agents that reason over customer world models and take actions in real environments.
Examples include:
• Tool use and planning
• Multi-step reasoning over customer state
• Autonomous workflow execution
• Recovery and adaptation under uncertainty
Learning from Feedback Loops
Developing methods that allow intelligence to improve continuously from real-world outcomes.
Examples include:
• Reinforcement learning from customer and product feedback
• Reward modeling and preference learning
• Counterfactual evaluation
• Credit assignment over long decision horizons
Evaluation and Measurement
Building evaluation frameworks that predict real-world performance, trust, and customer value.
Examples include:
• Simulated customer environments
• Longitudinal evaluation
• Decision quality metrics
• Safety and reliability benchmarks
What we're looking for
We're looking for researchers interested in building systems that understand people, learn from experience, and improve over time.

• Currently enrolled in an MS or PhD program in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related field, and returning to that program after the co-op.

About Apollo
Apollo leads Block's efforts to build the Customer World Model (CWM): a continuously evolving representation of each customer's goals, context, history, constraints, and likely future needs.
The CWM powers proactive intelligence across Block's ecosystem. Instead of customers navigating products in search of features, intelligence observes their world, understands what matters, anticipates what comes next, and initiates actions on their behalf.
We believe the next generation of AI products will not be defined by chat interfaces or isolated agents. They will be defined by rich world models that enable systems to reason over a customer's evolving state, make better decisions, and learn continuously from outcomes. Apollo designs, prototypes, and guides the development of this intelligence layer.

We're hiring a small cohort of graduate research interns to help build the foundations of proactive intelligence.
This is not a traditional internship. You'll own a research problem end-to-end: framing the question, developing methods, running experiments, publishing findings, and, when successful, shipping your work into production systems used by millions of customers and sellers.
You'll work at the intersection of representation learning, foundation models, reinforcement learning, causal reasoning, agentic systems, and product intelligence. Past interns have shipped production systems within months and published their work in the same year.

postings.title: Customer Experience Intern (Summer 2027)
postings.description:
Customer Experience Internship
We're Carvana. And we're on a mission to change the way people buy and sell cars.
We're a disruptor, an innovator, and a team that's obsessed with creating an unforgettable customer experience. And we believe that mission starts with our people.
That's where you come in.
About the internship: the ultimate customer operations bootcamp
Forget what you think you know about internships. This isn't your average "get coffee and make copies" gig. This is a 9-week (June 7 – August 6, 2027), paid, immersive bootcamp designed to teach you how to drive customers happy at one of the most innovative companies in business today.
You'll be embedded in our world-class Customer Experience team, learning from the ground up what it takes to deliver moments of magic to our customers. You'll also get exposure to our Market Operations team, so you can see the driveway and Vending Machine experience up close and appreciate the full, end-to-end car buying journey. Our goal is to give you a 360-degree view of that journey and empower you to make a real, tangible impact.
This is your chance to be part of a team that's making history, all while building a foundation for your future career.
We are investing in your development with the ultimate goal of you joining us full-time, so we're looking for candidates who are passionate about building their future at Carvana post-graduation.
What you'll be doing
• Learn from the best: You'll go through an accelerated training program designed to give you a deep understanding of our customers, our business, and our secret sauce for success.
• Become a customer champion: You'll be on the front lines, engaging with real customers through live interactions via phone and chat to solve problems and create exceptional experiences.
• See the full journey: Get exposure to the Market Operations side of the business and gain insight into the driveway and Vending Machine experience, so you understand how every step of the car buying process comes together.
• Experience our innovation firsthand: Step away from the desk and see what makes Carvana different. You'll get exclusive tours of our iconic Car Vending Machine and state-of-the-art Inspection Center as you learn about all the teams that bring the customer experience to life.
• Tackle a real business challenge: You and your fellow interns will team up on a hands-on capstone project, presenting your innovative solutions to our senior leadership team at the end of the summer.
• Get a seat at the table: Participate in exclusive lunch & learn sessions with our Executives, get a behind-the-scenes look at our operations, and build a professional network that will last a lifetime.
Your launchpad: where this internship can take you
At the end of the internship, full-time and part-time opportunities are available in our Advocate Operational roles, in either Customer Care or Market Operations. Those are your starting lines, not your finish line.
At Carvana, the growth doesn't stop in your first role. After 6 months, you become eligible to grow into other teams across the company. We have a ton of internal growth opportunities, and Customer Care is truly the launchpad for them. Because you've spent your time becoming the expert in the experiences we create for customers, you'll bring something every team values: a real understanding of the customer.
• Start: Join as an Advocate in Customer Care or Market Operations after graduation.
• Grow: Become eligible to move into other teams at the 6-month mark.
• Lead the way: Take the customer expertise you've built into whatever career you choose here.
What you should have
We're looking for people who are fired up about our mission and ready to learn. While we don't expect you to have any prior corporate experience, we are looking for:
• Currently enrolled in a four-year university and on track to graduate in Winter 2027 or Spring 2028 (i.e., a rising senior).
• A genuine obsession with helping people and a deep sense of empathy.
• An insatiable curiosity and a desire to understand the "why" behind the "what."
• A top-notch communicator: you're clear, concise, and can talk to just about anyone.
• A true team player who is always willing to lend a hand.
• Resilience and a positive, can-do attitude. You see challenges as opportunities.
What you'll get
• A paid, full-time 9-week internship at $20/hr.
• A pathway to a full-time Advocate Operational role in Customer Care or Market Operations, with eligibility to grow into other teams at the 6-month mark. We're not just looking for summer help; we're looking for our next generation of team members.
• A hands-on learning experience that will look amazing on your resume and serve as a launchpad for your career, whether that's with us or beyond.
• Direct mentorship and coaching from a dedicated manager and a team that is invested in your growth.
• Unparalleled access to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
• An unforgettable summer filled with learning, development, and fun.
• And, of course, some seriously cool Carvana swag.
Interested?
If you're ready to roll up your sleeves, make a difference, and launch your career at a company that's changing the entire car-buying industry, we want to hear from you.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We provide advice in relation to all types of competition matters, including mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance, cartels, market investigations, intellectual property, and state aid. We have played a key role in many cases that have shaped European competition policy in recent years: from aerospace to software, and manufacturing to transportation. More recently, we have been at the forefront of economic thinking in antitrust investigations and regulation in the tech sector.
Interns work closely with senior staff on projects across a variety of industries and will gain a good understanding of what it is like to work as an economist at CRA. An intern would typically:
• Conduct analyses and collect evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations
• Perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring the use of cloud computing
• Build economic models tailored to the issues at hand and supporting our expert opinions and business recommendations
• Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers
• Communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to internal teams in an understandable, accessible manner
• Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions.
Desired Qualifications
• Master's or PhD candidates studying economics with a strong foundation in microeconomics, preferably with a specialisation in industrial economics and/or econometrics
• Fluency in English, other language skills are considered an asset
• High degree of numeracy, ability to analyse data, familiarity with econometric techniques
• Exceptional written and oral communication skills
• Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities
• Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills
To Apply
To be considered for this position, please submit the following:
• Curriculum Vitae– please include current contact information
• Cover letter– please describe your interest in CRA’s European Competition practice and state when you would be available
• Academic results– from all relevant degrees
• Writing sample (optional)– a sole-authored project (class paper, thesis, research paper, or similar)
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The internship duration is usually three to six months, with flexible start dates throughout the year. The internship is paid, and we welcome candidates who are available to start from January 2027 onwards.

Charles River Associates creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 days a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another Charles River Associates office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team. At certain times of the year (e.g. holiday periods), additional remote work options are offered to those whose work commitments permit it, although our offices remain open for those who choose or need to be there.
Internship Benefits
As an intern in our Munich office, you will have access to a monthly mobility allowance, which can be used towards your commute or other eligible travel expenses. You will also enjoy weekly team lunches and be invited to regular social events, providing great opportunities to connect with colleagues and build your network within the firm.
Our Commitment to Diversity
Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

postings.title: PhD GenAI Research Scientist Intern
postings.description:
Company Description:
At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world’s best data and AI platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions.
The Mosaic AI organization enables companies to develop AI models and systems using their own data, with technologies ranging from fine-tuning LLMs for enterprise domains, to a platform for building compound AI systems that use retrieval and agents. Mosaic AI is committed to the belief that a company’s AI models are just as valuable as any other core IP, and that high-quality AI models should be available to all.
Job description:
Most of the world's data+AI problems lie in enterprise domains, behind closed doors. Our research team's goal is to push the frontier of "domain adaptation" - how can we develop LLMs and AI systems that work well for custom domains. To do this we are tackling open research problems on a range of topics, from how to scale/automate eval, fine tune with synthetic data, retrieval augmentation, fast/efficient inference and more.
You will work with our research team on projects focused on adapting LLMs and AI systems towards enterprise domains. This may include:
• Adapting, improving, and evaluating a method from the literature.
• Designing an entirely new method for domain adaptation.
• Composing together multiple methods to create new recipes for efficient post-training.
• Evaluation of LLMs and AI systems.
Your qualifications and qualities:
• Required:
• Research experience in and proficiency with the fundamentals of deep learning.
• Pursuing a PhD in computer science or related fields (electrical engineering, neuroscience, physics, math, etc.).
• Proficient software engineering skills, including with PyTorch.

postings.title: Applied Science Intern
postings.description:
As an Applied Science Intern, you will join a cross-functional team of engineers and applied scientists building AI-powered features within the Datadog platform. You will contribute to both existing and new products by improving machine learning models, developing new AI capabilities, and helping bring research into production. Working closely with engineering and product partners, you'll gain hands-on experience deploying AI systems at scale while strengthening your product mindset, collaboration, and communication skills. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that directly powers customer-facing features.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.
What You’ll Do:
• Design solutions for AI use cases by researching and benchmarking state-of-the-art models to identify the best approach
• Build highly scalable product features using generative AI, machine learning algorithms, and statistical techniques
• Contribute to the development, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of production AI models, services, and infrastructure
• Explore, analyze, and derive insights from the large-scale observability data flowing through Datadog systems
• Participate in technical knowledge sharing by presenting recent academic research and investigating emerging model architectures to improve existing and future products
• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to productionize AI solutions and deliver customer-facing features
Who You Are:
• You will graduate in 2027 with a degree in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field
• You have experience building machine learning models through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects
• You have strong programming skills and are eager to learn new languages and technologies
• You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
• You have a strong interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven product development
• Available to complete a 6-month internship beginning in February, March, April, May, or June 2027 (we are unable to accommodate internships starting at any other time)
Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.
Benefits and Growth:
• Work on meaningful technical challenges alongside engineers across the globe
• Participate in mentorship and buddy programs designed to support learning and development
• Join an in-person intern cohort, attend company social events, and engage with Datadog Community Guilds and employee resource groups throughout the internship
• Receive relocation support and travel benefits where applicable
• Enjoy office perks including snacks, drinks, and catered lunches on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday
Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.
Please ensure that you submit your CV/resume in English. If possible, please apply using your personal email address instead of your university email address.
Students can sign up for a free Datadog Pro account to learn more about our platform and products.

postings.title: IT Support Technician Intern
postings.description:
The Enterprise IT Support team is responsible for the hardware and software that Datadog employees around the world use on a daily basis to successfully do their jobs.
As an Enterprise IT Support intern, you will combine theoretical learning at your school with practical, hands-on experience in our IT Support team. Over the course of your internship, you will progressively take on more responsibilities while helping ensure our ever-growing user base has everything they need to do their job. You’ll also gain exposure to security-adjacent tasks relevant to IT support operations.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.
What You’ll Do
• Learn and assist in providing customer service and technical support for our employees
• Shadow and support laptop deployment as part of onboarding and refresh cycles
• Shadow and support laptop collection and account deactivation as part of employee offboarding cycles
• Participate in new hire orientations to understand policies, best practices and services used within Datadog
• Assist with general ticketing, account management, and basic troubleshooting under supervision
• Help maintain hardware and software inventory
• Contribute to documentation creation and maintenance
• Observe and support unified communications setups in conference rooms and common areas
• Participate in team meetings and knowledge-sharing sessions
• Gain exposure to deployment and security-related projects
• Support multi-factor authentication (MFA/2FA) setup and troubleshooting for employees
• Observe and support endpoint device enrollment using mobile device management (MDM) tools
• Gain familiarity with access management principles, including the processes used to grant, review, and revoke employee access
• Assist in following established procedures when responding to basic IT Security incidents under supervision
• Participate in identity verification processes
• Develop skills in various SaaS tools and IT workflows
Who You Are:
• You will graduate in 2027 with a degree in IT, Cybersecurity field
• This internship is required as part of your academic curriculum
• You are passionate about technology and eager to learn
• You love working in a team and helping people
• You have a basic understanding of computer hardware and software

postings.title: Research Science Intern (PhD)
locations: New York, New York, USA; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA
postings.description:
Datadog AI Research — Scholars Program with Carnegie Mellon University
Datadog AI Research (DAIR) is partnering with Carnegie Mellon University to support a small number of PhD students working on open research problems grounded by ongoing efforts at Datadog/DAIR.
You will frame a problem, run your own experiments, and write up what you find, with compute and data at a scale most academic labs cannot provide. You will collaborate with colleagues working on the same questions.
The Lab And The Research:
DAIR is an industrial research lab motivated by practical challenges in observability and software operation: detecting and diagnosing failures, understanding complex production environments, and helping engineers operate software more effectively. The lab focuses on creating specialized foundation models, post-training and evaluating AI agents, and building frontier-scale machine learning systems. By combining fundamental research with Datadog's large-scale, real-world data and infrastructure, the lab develops new AI capabilities and translates them into practical systems with meaningful impact.
Internship projects are shaped with your DAIR mentor and your CMU faculty advisor. You do not need prior experience with observability, monitoring, or infrastructure.
What You'll Do:
• Own a research project end to end: framing the question, running the experiments, writing it up
• Work directly with a DAIR mentor engaged in the same problem, and stay connected to your advisor and lab
• Publish, and use the work toward your dissertation
• See research reach production, when it works
Who You Are:
• Currently enrolled in a PhD program at Carnegie Mellon in machine learning, computer science, statistics, or a related field
• Depth in at least one area relevant to the research above
• Comfort running real experiments — training models, working with GPUs, reading and reimplementing recent papers
• Evidence you can do research: conference or workshop papers, preprints, open-source contributions, or a lab project you can discuss in depth
• Research taste. You can explain why a problem matters and what would change if it were solved.
• Honest empiricism. You report the ablation that didn't work.
• Support from your faculty advisor.
Not Required:
• A long publication record. How you think matters more than how much you've published.
• Observability, monitoring, or SRE background.
• A perfect match to the areas above.

postings.title: AI/ML Research Intern
postings.description:
Our formula for success is to hire exceptional people, encourage their ideas and reward their results.
As an AI/ML Research Intern, you will be an integral member of a team of experienced technologists, quantitative researchers, and traders. You will collaborate closely with other researchers to solve challenging AI and machine learning problems. Your projects will vary depending on priorities at the start of your employment and could include solving forecasting problems or developing large language models (LLMs). We are looking for individuals eager to learn new AI technologies, create innovative solutions, and choose the right tools to directly impact our business. You will be surrounded by cutting-edge technology, given immediate responsibility, mentored by industry-leading experts, and attend a robust training program to ensure your success at DRW.
How will you make an impact?
• Designing and implementing large scale deep learning models for computer vision, reinforcement learning, graph neural networks or similar domain
• Improving our data and data pipelines
• Time series forecasting
• Applying deep learning methods to telemetry data (sensor data and metrics collected from intelligent devices)
What do you bring to the team?
• Are pursuing a master’s, or PhD (preferred) degree in a technical discipline focusing on machine learning, deep learning or NLP graduating between December 2027 and June 2028

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ENGINEERING - EPIC GAMES SERVICES
What We Do
Driving the plug-in power behind Unreal Engine 5. We bridge connections for licensees and our own internal game teams to online services. This allows games like Fortnite to utilize a combination of platform online services as well as Epic’s own online services to build cross-platform online features. Login, parties, voice chat, matchmaking, purchasing, cloud storage, and analytics are just a few examples of online features that our Online Game Services team helps games utilize.
BACKEND SERVICES PROGRAMMER INTERN
What You'll Do
We are looking for a Backend Engineer Intern to join us to continue to build the system that powers Fortnite. You'll work on the team responsible for things like running FNCS tournaments, storing player cosmetics and Sprites, and persisting LEGO Fortnite worlds. You will be given a feature to own as part of our development cycle, and be integrated in the day-to-day of the team.
In this role, you will
• Contribute to the backend systems that power Fortnite experiences
• Learn about security, scalability, and maintainability in the code you write
• Collaborate with a team of highly experienced engineers
• Work with Fortnite product owners and producers to figure out solutions that empower the upcoming seasons of Fortnite
What we're looking for
• Proficiency in Java or similar object-oriented programming language
• Experience with AI-assisted coding tools, such as Claude code
• Ability to communicate effectively and provide task updates in a remote-first team environment
• Willingness to ask questions, seek guidance, and learn from feedback
• Foundational analytical and problem-solving skills
• Familiarity with cloud technologies, particularly AWS, is preferred
• Familiarity with *nix based systems is a plus
This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. This is going to be Epic!
ABOUT US
Epic Games is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.
Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!
Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.

What We Do
Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.
ENGINE PROGRAMMER INTERN
What You'll Do
We are looking for an Engine Programmer Intern to join the team building a new serialization stack for Unreal Engine. This schema-based serialization system will be at the heart of how engine content is saved, loaded, and versioned. As part of the serialization team you will be given a feature to own within our development cycle — such as schema evolution, data migration / recovery, type bindings, or debug tooling. You will work with your engineering lead and partner-teams across the engine to flesh out the system and build core technology that millions of players and creators rely on every day.
In this role, you will
• Design and implement a feature within the serialization stack, taking it from proposal to shipped code with guidance from your engineering lead
• Write high-performance, memory-efficient C++ for systems where correctness and backwards compatibility are critical
• Build tooling that helps users work with serialized data — such as diffing, visualization, and human-readable text formats
• Develop thorough unit tests to guarantee data integrity across save, load, and version-upgrade paths
• Collaborate with partner teams across the engine to integrate the serialization system with their data and workflows
• Participate in code reviews and design discussions, learning how core engine technology is built and maintained at scale
What we're looking for
• Strong C++ fundamentals, including a solid grasp of memory management, pointers, and familiarity with the fundamentals of template
• Good understanding of data structures and how data is laid out and represented in memory
• Interest in low-level systems programming — file formats, binary data, compilers, or engine internals
• A rigorous, detail-oriented approach
• Being comfortable debugging unfamiliar code and methodically tracking down the root cause of a problem
• Being able to explain a technical design and ask good questions
• Self-driven, eager to learn, and open to feedback, using it to improve your work

As part of Fortnite's Engagement Product Management team, you will improve the efficiency of how product management operates at Fortnite scale, while providing engagement insights to development teams and executive leadership.

• Improve the efficiency of core PM workflows such as recurring engagement reporting, cohort anomaly detection, CCU projections, and a comprehensive Fortnite product context knowledge base for LLM use

• Deliver engagement product analysis and strategic recommendations for Battle Royale, Reload, and other shooter modes, working across disciplines to answer the team's highest-priority product questions

QUALITY ASSURANCE
What We Do
The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.
SDET INTERN
What You'll Do
Epic Games Art Ops team is looking for a smart, creative Software Development Engineer in Test Intern. Art Ops is the team that builds the tools, pipelines, and Al workflows our artists use for game development and emerging tech every day. This role focuses on testing those internal tools and frameworks; you'll embed with our team of engineers and technical artists to help design and build everything from Cl pipelines, test plans, and integration tests for our web apps to checks that tell us how well our Al tools are performing.
In this role, you will
• Write test plans for new tools and features, then turn them into automated tests
• Help design and build the test framework our team will use going forward, with our engineers reviewing your code
• Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for our web apps and pipeline tools
• Test how Al tools and workflows perform when new models are released, and help build ways to measure their performance
• Support weekly release testing and turn repeated manual checks into automated tests
• Investigate test failures, determine why a test broke, and share results with the team
• Use Al-assisted tools to help run, write, and triage tests, and review what they produce
What we're looking for
• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field
• Comfortable writing code in at least one modern OOP language such as Python, C++, or C#, through coursework or personal projects
• Basic understanding of software testing, such as unit and integration testing
• Familiarity with a version control system
• Interest in Al for content and code generation
• Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to confidently collaborate with senior team members and take feedback on technical topics and features
• Willingness to dive into new things and drive them forward
• A personal project repository or demo portfolio is required

• Exposure to art tools such as Unreal Engine, Maya, or Houdini, or interest in how artists work is highly desired

ART
What We Do
Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.
TECH ART INTERN
What You'll Do
We are looking for a Technical Art Intern to join the Rocket League team. You will sit between our artists and engineers: building tools that speed up how content gets into the build, authoring real-time materials, and profiling scenes so the game holds frame rate everywhere from mobile to high-refresh PC. You will have an impact on real work that ships into playable builds.
In this role, you will
• Build small pipeline tools and scripts (Python, UEFN/Verse, DCC scripting APIs) that automate repetitive steps for arena, vehicle, and cosmetics artists
• Profile arenas and assets in engine, then help fix what you find: draw calls, overdraw, texture memory, LODs, and vertex budgets
• Author and iterate on real-time materials and shaders for signature Rocket League surfaces
• Take assets from Maya, Blender, or Substance through to an optimized, working setup in engine and validate them in a playable build
• Work directly with technical artists, rendering engineers, and environment artists to unblock issues and document what you learn
• Show your work in art reviews and playtests, take feedback, and iterate quickly
What we're looking for
• Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Technical Art, Computer Science, Digital Media, or Game Development program, or a portfolio strong enough to stand in for one
• Scripting experience in Python, C#, or a DCC scripting API. Bonus if you have written something that saved someone else time
• Hands-on with at least one 3D package (Maya, 3ds Max, or Blender) and the Substance suite
• Working knowledge of Unreal Engine
• Solid real-time rendering fundamentals: how lighting, shading, UV layout, texture memory, and poly budgets affect performance
• Genuine curiosity about performance. You like finding out why a frame is slow
• Clear, proactive communication. You raise blockers early instead of quietly grinding on them
• A portfolio or reel showing technical art work: tools, shaders, procedural systems, or optimization case studies

TECHNICAL PRODUCT MANAGEMENT INTERN
What You'll Do
We are building the Discover Publish Tool to help our creators and partners manage and publish their content. As a Technical Product Management Intern, you will help define and ship improvements to this tooling and get hands-on experience taking a product idea from problem definition through delivery. You'll work closely with engineers, the product lead, and the operators who use the tool every day to understand problems, write clear requirements, make scope tradeoffs, and test what gets built. Along the way, you'll learn from an experienced product manager and gain hands-on experience with the tools, processes, and practices used to build high-quality products. By the end of the internship, you'll have shipped a real product improvement that our partners use.

• Define scoped product improvements for Discover by writing clear requirements, user flows, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the product lead

postings.title: Applied AI/ML Scientist, Intern
postings.description:
About Faire
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.
About this role
Our Applied AI/ML Science team builds and maintains the models that power the marketplace. That work includes the shipping and delivery estimates retailers rely on as they shop and check out: what it will cost to ship and when it will arrive, before the order has been packed. Within Applied Science, our Shipping and Fulfillment team builds the models behind those estimates, including models that learn to understand products from images and text. Better predictions give retailers confidence in what they're buying and, in turn, help brands sell more on Faire.
What you will be doing
You'll own a focused project in one of these areas:
• Predicting how an order will be packed: Before an order ships, we have to anticipate how it will be packed. You'll build models that learn from what each item is and how items combine in a cart.
• Recommending better ways to pack: How an order is packed shapes what it costs to ship. You'll develop models that understand items from images and text and learn from historical packing outcomes to recommend packing that reduces shipping cost and improves efficiency.
• Understanding products from a catalog: Listings often lack reliable weight, size and shape. You'll train multimodal deep learning models that infer these physical characteristics from images, text and other catalog signals.
Whichever project you take on, you will:
• Survey the literature and existing approaches to identify promising ideas
• Prototype and train models offline, benchmarking against our current methods
• Build out the strongest approach into a working implementation
• Work with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to test it against live traffic
• Present findings and recommendations to the team
What it takes
• Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Master's or PhD program in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
• Hands-on experience building deep learning models (e.g., PyTorch), ideally with images, text, or both, including fine-tuning pre-trained models or working with embeddings
• Familiarity with gradient-boosted trees and other tabular ML methods
• Strong Python and SQL
• Ability to read research papers and turn promising ideas into working code
• Solid grounding in statistics and model evaluation, including benchmarking against strong baselines and estimating uncertainty
• Comfort working with noisy or incomplete real-world data
• A genuine enthusiasm for tackling ambiguous problems and learning new tools and techniques
Internship Details
This paid Winter 2027 internship runs for 12 to 14 weeks, beginning in January 2027, with flexible start dates available for qualified candidates. Extensions may be offered based on project needs and mutual agreement.
Pay rate
San Francisco: the pay rate for this role is $75 USD per hour.
Actual hourly pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
Faire uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) to screen and select applicants for this position.
This job posting is for an existing vacancy.
#LI-DNI
Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.
Why you’ll love working at Faire
• Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.
• Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.
• Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.
• Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.
• Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.
Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog.

postings.title: Completions Engineering Internship
postings.description:
About Fervo Energy
Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America’s most dependable and affordable source of clean, around-the-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future.
Internship Overview
You won't be running coffee orders or shuffling paperwork this summer. At Fervo, interns are handed something real: a project of your own, scoped with your manager on day one and yours to drive for the full 12 weeks. You'll work side-by-side with the teams building the next generation of geothermal energy, tackling problems that genuinely move the business forward. At the end of the summer, you'll present your work to our executive leadership team, department leads, and fellow interns, sharing real results with a real audience. This is a real seat at the table — and a real shot at what comes next.
Position Description
Fervo Energy is developing next-generation geothermal power to deliver firm, carbon-free energy at scale, anchored by our flagship Cape Station project in Milford, Utah. As a Completions Intern, you'll get hands-on exposure across the full completions lifecycle — completion design, well construction, field execution, and post-fracturing analysis. You'll work closely with Fervo's completions engineers on data analysis, technical reporting, and emerging technologies, with strong performers considered for a full-time offer on the Drilling & Completions team.
Responsibilities
• Support completion design workflows and documentation
• Assist with hydraulic stimulation data collection and analysis
• Maintain and update well diagrams and completion records
• Support vendor coordination and scheduling
• Track completions performance metrics and help prepare summary reports
Qualifications
Required
• Rising Junior, Senior, Master's/MBA candidate wrapping up within the next year, or PhD candidate — we're building a pipeline toward full-time offers
• Pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or Chemical Engineering (other core technical majors considered)
• Minimum GPA of 3.0
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to stakeholders and leadership
• Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and adapt quickly to new challenges
• Comfort working with technical field data
• Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
Preferred
• Previous Drilling & Completions or oil & gas industry experience
• A genuine, well-articulated interest in Fervo and geothermal energy — a thoughtful, tailored cover letter is a plus
Location
Fervo Energy has offices in Houston, TX, Golden, CO, Reno, NV, Oakland, CA, and Salt Lake City, UT. This position will be eligible for some hybrid work flexibility, but regular in-office presence in Houston will be required.
Benefits & Perks
• Fervo offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Benefits for eligible employees include:
• Medical, dental, and vision plan options
• Employer-paid basic life insurance and short-term and long-term disability coverage
• A 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar company match
• Flexible paid time off and paid parental leave
• Family-building, fertility, hormonal health, pregnancy, postpartum, and parenting support through Carrot
• A dependent care FSA for eligible child and elder care expenses
• An annual Lifestyle Spending Account for eligible wellness expenses, including fitness, financial planning, pet insurance, and pet care
• Employee ownership opportunities through Fervo’s Employee Stock Purchase Program, as well as stock option grants and bonus opportunities for eligible roles
Benefits and programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may change.
Our Workplace
Fervo Energy highly values having employees work in the office to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. This role follows a hybrid schedule, with team members expected to work in the office three days per week. Fervo considers this in-office schedule an essential function of the role. Your recruiter can share more information about the schedule.
Equal Opportunity Employer
Fervo Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, gender, religion, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sex, genetic information, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local law. Fervo also prohibits discrimination based on the perception that an individual has any of these characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of these characteristics.

The Portfolio Management department’s primary focus is to construct and monitor the customized and commingled portfolios the firm manages in our ARS group. The department constructs forward-looking allocation plans that align with GCM Grosvenor’s current investment views while ensuring compliance with each portfolio’s stated objectives and constraints. The Portfolio Management team works closely with other departments including our Research, Risk Management, and Operations teams on investments-related work. In addition, Portfolio Management works closely with our Business Development, Marketing and Legal groups to create portfolio proposals in pursuit of new business, and further develop existing business relationships. The role of a Portfolio Management Intern focuses in the areas of investments, client servicing and operations.

• Construct forward-looking portfolio plans that allocate client capital to various hedge funds.

The Department: Marketing
The Prediction Markets Operations team turns real-world events into clearly defined event contracts. We support markets across their full lifecycle—from an initial idea, through configuration and launch, into live operations, and finally to accurate resolution. Our work sits at the intersection of current events, marketplaces, and regulated products, and it demands precision at every step.
The team is responsible for making sure every contract is: clearly and objectively written, based on reliable, authoritative resolution sources, accurately configured, supported with appropriate images and content, thoroughly reviewed before launch, monitored while live, and resolved accurately and consistently.
The Role: Prediction Markets Operations Intern
This is a detail-oriented, hands-on internship for someone interested in marketplaces, operations, current events, financial technology, or regulated products. You will perform time-sensitive operational work and learn firsthand how prediction markets move from an idea to a live and, ultimately, settled contract.
Success in this role depends on accuracy, sound judgment, reliability, and operational discipline. Just as important is the willingness to escalate uncertainty rather than guess. You will support, coordinate, research, prepare, review, and execute work under established procedures, working closely with partners across Prediction Markets, Operations, Customer Support, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Design, Marketing, and our liquidity partners.
This will be a semester long internship program with 3 days a week in person at our New York City, NY office from January to April 2027.
Responsibilities:
Contract Research and Market Listings
• Research potential prediction-market contract ideas.
• Help turn ideas into precise, objective binary questions.
• Identify reliable and authoritative public resolution sources.
• Flag ambiguity, potentially prohibited subject matter, or questions requiring Compliance or Legal review.
• Prepare contract specifications, including outcomes, dates, descriptions, tickers, resolution criteria, and other listing details.
• Create and configure event contracts in the Contract Management System, or assist with structured CSV uploads, under established procedures.
• Support research and documentation related to product requirements and filings.
Quality Assurance and Launch Operations
• Perform pre-launch and post-upload quality assurance.
• Verify contract names, outcomes, ordering, start times, expiration times, resolution criteria, and designated sources.
• Review dates and times carefully, including UTC-based fields.
• Compare contracts with relevant external prediction markets when appropriate, and identify unintended differences in outcomes, timing, or mechanics.
• Confirm that event and social images are present and appropriate.
• Upload or update approved event images, social images, and display settings.
• Coordinate launch information with internal stakeholders and liquidity partners.
• Identify discrepancies and escalate issues before launch.
Customer and Live-Market Support
• Review, triage, and investigate prediction-market support tickets.
• Gather relevant facts, document findings, and route issues appropriately.
• Monitor live markets for incorrect content, timing discrepancies, operational issues, or unexpected behavior.
• Follow established incident-escalation procedures when urgent technical or operational issues arise.
• Maintain accurate trackers, checklists, SOPs, and internal documentation.
• Identify opportunities to improve repetitive workflows and reduce manual work.
Market Monitoring and Resolution
• Monitor contracts approaching expiration or awaiting resolution.
• Research outcomes using the contract’s designated resolution source.
• Prepare a proposed outcome, source links, and a concise rationale for internal review.
• Double-check resolution information against authoritative sources.
• Escalate unclear, conflicting, delayed, or incomplete source information rather than guessing.
• Execute approved market settlements in the Contract Management System after required training, review, and approval.
• Settlement activity is performed only under established procedures, supervision, access controls, and approval requirements. Accuracy is critical, because completed settlements may not be reversible.
• Document completed resolutions according to team procedures.
Scheduled Monitoring Coverage
• Participate in a scheduled rotation for brief evening or weekend monitoring.
• This is lightweight, scheduled coverage—not continuous or unrestricted on-call work.
• Interns will primarily identify and escalate issues to the appropriate full-time team.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Associate’s, or Master’s degree.
• Exceptional attention to detail.
• Strong written communication.
• Ability to research information and distinguish authoritative sources from unreliable ones.
• Sound judgment and a willingness to escalate uncertainty.
• Comfort with detailed, repeatable, process-driven tasks.
• Ability to manage time-sensitive work without sacrificing accuracy.
• Dependability and follow-through…

postings.description:
About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.
About the Role:
As a Finance Intern on Gusto’s Finance, BizOps & Strategy (FBOS) team, you’ll spend 12 weeks working on real projects that shape how we run the business. You’ll support leaders in Customer Experience, EPD, and Corporate Development, helping turn financial data into decisions about margin, cost to serve, and resourcing. Day to day, that means building financial reports, analyzing costs to find savings, and partnering with teams across Gusto on projects that move the team’s roadmap forward. Along the way, you’ll use AI tools and automation to work faster and go deeper than a traditional finance internship allows.
You’ll be paired with a dedicated mentor and a team manager who will support you from onboarding through your final presentation. By the end of the summer, you’ll have seen firsthand how finance works as a true partner to the business.
Please note: We’ll be offering only one cohort start and end date (Cohort 1: May 17, 2027 - August 6, 2027).
Deadline to Apply: Monday, October 26th at 4:00 pm PST
About the Team:
You'll join Gusto's Finance, BizOps & Strategy (FBOS) team, which provides financial, operational, and strategic support at the corporate, department, and product level as we scale to serve even more customers. Our partners sit directly inside business orgs like Customer Experience, EPD, and Corporate Development, translating financial data into operating decisions on margin, cost to serve, and resourcing. As Gusto evolves into an AI native company, we're using automation, predictive insights, and smarter data systems to define and defend our business model while accelerating growth. As a Finance Intern, you'll see firsthand how finance works as a true partner to the business rather than a back office function.
Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:
• Work cross-functionally on high-impact projects that use data, automation, and AI-powered tools
• Build and maintain recurring financial/operational reporting for your partner org
• Analyze cost or margin drivers and summarize findings for non-finance stakeholders
• Support a defined roadmap project end-to-end alongside your mentor
• Partner with CX/EPD/Corp Dev counterparts on data requests and ad hoc analysis
Here’s what we're looking for:
• Rising junior or senior (entering your 3rd or 4th year after this internship)
• Demonstrates genuine interest in financial trends, technology innovation, and applying classroom knowledge to real business challenges
• Comfortable working in Excel/Google Sheets; curious about how AI tools can speed up analysis work
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to communicate findings clearly to non-finance stakeholders
• Self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment
Our cash compensation amount for this role is $32.70/hr for undergraduate students in Denver and $42.07/hr for undergraduate students in New York.
At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

postings.title: Computational Plasma Research Summer 2027 Intern
postings.description:
About Helion
We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.
Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.
This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.
What You Will Be Doing:
The computational research team at Helion works with multiple plasma simulation codes to simulate and analyze Helion’s fusion machines and test beds. The goal of the simulation effort is to develop predictive computational capabilities derived from first principles, validated against experimental data across multiple FRC merging devices, to inform next-generation fusion machine design.
You Will:
• Be responsible for using Helion’s computational suite of tools to study a particular aspect of the machine, which could include FRC formation, translation, merging, or compression
• Work with your team and mentor to develop a simulation study and develop a set of results
• Develop a report and present your findings to the broader research team at Helion
Required Skills:
• Ability to work full time, onsite in Everett, WA for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks during summer 2027
• Currently pursuing a PhD in Physics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, with relevant experience in plasmas
• Must be able to complete their PhD program and commence full-time employment no later than May 2028
• GPA of 3.0 or above
• Experience working with plasma simulation codes (e.g. PIC, Vlasov codes, MHD)
• Experience doing research in a team environment
• Scripting and analysis in Python, C++ or MATLAB
